Name: ROCKETSHIP DCE/T1 parity and phantom-qualification test dataset
Description: Small synthetic BIDS dataset used by the ROCKETSHIP test suite for MATLAB<->Python parity and synthetic-phantom ground-truth qualification. Subjects sub-01..sub-04 are a real-style reference example (BIDS_example sub-01) plus derived variants; subjects sub-05..sub-09 are fully synthetic DCE phantoms that ship voxelwise ground-truth maps. Not intended for scientific reuse.
